subject.title: Feature: Auto session split when approaching context window limit

question: Should OpenClaw add token-pressure-based automatic session rollover with durable handoff, and should it be separate from or folded into broader session TTL/max-turn rotation?
rationale: The request changes public session lifecycle config and cross-boundary continuity semantics for session store, transcript, memory, channel delivery, and provider-owned runtime state.

options.title: Design one opt-in lifecycle policy
options.body: Define token-pressure rollover, durable handoff, delivery identity preservation, config, docs, and tests as one explicit core session lifecycle design.

options.title: Fold into TTL rotation work
options.body: Track token-pressure rollover as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45390 so age, turn-count, and token-pressure rotation share one policy surface.

options.title: Defer automatic rollover
options.body: Keep compaction and manual/daily/idle reset as the supported mitigations while documenting that proactive rotation remains operator-managed for now.

recommendation.title: Design one opt-in lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Define token-pressure rollover, durable handoff, delivery identity preservation, config, docs, and tests as one explicit core session lifecycle design.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the cross-boundary session, compaction, and product-policy decision points to steipete.
